title: GitHub runner capacity enablement
purpose: Record the trust posture, host/controller inspection, runner registration, safe workflow routing, callback decision, fallback, cleanup proof, and timing evidence boundary for trusted GitHub runner capacity.

currentObservations.registrationTokenReason: A short-lived repository runner registration token was requested through GitHub CLI only after this host/controller was authorised and the dedicated runner user/workspace existed. The token was not printed, committed, or persisted and is treated as spent.
currentObservations.currentValidateWorkflowRunsOn: trusted self-hosted labels for trusted main and same-repository PRs, ubuntu-latest fallback for fork PRs and manual fallback

pendingAfterEvidence.recordingLocation: PR body and generated GitHub step summary; repository artefact records schema and boundary until after-run evidence is captured.

trusted-main.description: main, workflow_dispatch on main, scheduled trusted runs, and repository-owner-approved contexts.

trusted-pr.description: Pull requests from trusted branches in this repository.

untrusted-pr.description: Fork pull requests or code from actors without write trust.

privileged-ci.description: CI that may use secrets or write cache and evidence only where explicitly authorised.

unprivileged-ci.description: CI that must not access secrets, write trusted cache, mutate repository, or persist trusted state.

safeFutureRoutingPreconditions: At least one online repository runner has the required USF-specific labels.
The runner host/controller is dedicated to USF CI with documented ownership and cleanup controls.
Untrusted fork pull requests remain on GitHub-hosted runners or on a separately proven ephemeral unprivileged runner.
The required validate context remains stable.
GitHub-hosted fallback remains documented and testable.
runnerRoutingPolicy.manualGithubHostedFallback: repository variable USF_VALIDATE_RUNNER_TARGET=github-hosted or workflow_dispatch runnerTarget=github-hosted
runnerRoutingPolicy.sameRepositoryPullRequestRouting: self-hosted linux x64 usf usf-ci usf-trusted
runnerRoutingPolicy.mainPushRouting: self-hosted linux x64 usf usf-ci usf-trusted

ephemeralRequirements: Runner is registered for one job or one bounded trusted run.
Workspace is destroyed after the job.
Tool and package caches are scoped outside trusted evidence and secret paths.
Registration, execution, cleanup, and removal are recorded as operational evidence.
persistentRequirements: Dedicated USF runner user with minimal host privileges.
No Docker socket or broad host mounts unless separately justified.
Workspace cleanup before and after every job.
Cache directories isolated from proof evidence, generated reports, secrets, and repository write credentials.
Secrets are not written to the workspace.
Runner version and update policy recorded.
Rollback to GitHub-hosted runner documented and tested.

caddyCallbackDecision.reason: This host now provides direct runner capacity and GitHub Actions API plus runner health checks provide queue, timing, and online status evidence. Caddy/callback routes are not needed for basic runner enablement and would add public ingress, signature, replay, and rollback surface without materially improving the current bottleneck.
caddyCallbackDecision.futureConditionForUse: A later queue-aware runner controller or health service needs authenticated workflow_job events, runner health handoff, or registration coordination beyond GitHub API polling and systemd health.

exactRemainingBlockers: A trusted self-hosted validate run must complete after this workflow routing change is pushed.
After-run timing fields must be recorded before Linear closure.
GitHub-hosted fallback must be verified or explicitly recorded as manual fallback-ready.
PR body and Linear must be updated with run evidence and acceptance criteria after CI completes.

nextUnblockers.requirement: Push the routing change and capture the validate job on usf-linux-x64-controller-01.
Confirm workflow postflight and runner hook cleanup evidence after the self-hosted job.
Verify the GitHub-hosted fallback switch or record the manual fallback command and status.

enablementDecision.fallbackPath: Set repository variable USF_VALIDATE_RUNNER_TARGET=github-hosted using tools/github-runner/rollback-to-github-hosted.sh set, or manually revert validate runs-on to ubuntu-latest while preserving the validate context.

exactBlockers: No owner cost decision is recorded for larger GitHub-hosted runners.
No larger-runner availability or label has been proven for the personal repository context.
No before-and-after larger-runner timing run exists.
No workflow fallback from a larger runner to ubuntu-latest has been validated.
largerGithubHostedRunnerDecision.fallbackPath: Continue using ubuntu-latest until a cost and availability decision is recorded.

validationRequirements: Strict JSON parse for this artefact.
validate-spec and validate-spec selftest because workflow routing changed.
Proof-cockpit validation after source freshness is re-pinned.
GitHub CI evidence on the self-hosted runner.
GitHub-hosted fallback proof or documented fallback verification.
Caddy webhook negative tests only if callback functionality is implemented.

runnerInstallation.ephemeralNotAdoptedReason: A one-shot ephemeral runner is not practical for durable PR routing without a separately implemented queue-aware controller. The safer first slice on this authorised host is a persistent runner service with a dedicated unprivileged user, no Docker group, isolated work/cache/temp directories, cleanup hooks, and GitHub-hosted fallback.
